The CDF entry spans detector configurations. INSPIRE separates the original detector, its Run I upgrade, and Run II. The 1995 top discovery belongs to the Run I period, so the original pre-upgrade record alone is insufficient. Upgrade-component subprojects are not treated as the whole detector.
